identity.fantasy: A macabre combat medic who transfers blood between bodies, converts attacks into healing, and rewrites incoming damage through organs, bindings, shields, and stored vitality.
identity.one_line: A blood-transfer healer that stores, redistributes, shields, binds, and purifies health through Sanguine Essence and organ-themed spells. It can heal through attacks in a fistweaver-like style and manipulate incoming damage, but requires careful resource and target management.

mechanics.core_loop: Use Dark Liturgy to establish Blood Ritual recipients, attack through Bloodmoon Blast and later proc-enabled damage so allies carrying the ritual are healed, manage Sanguine Essence and instant Sanguine Mend access, and reserve Aortic Aegis, Arterial Bind, Blood Redistribution, or Purify Blood for dangerous events.

modes.name: Sanguine Essence
modes.structural_description: Transform: s your Blood Curse into Sanguine Essence.Sanguine Essence (Cursed Form)Enter a unique Cursed Form that does not disable Mortal Form abilties, coalescing a blood orb that will float beside you.While active, you replicate 20% of healing or damage done by Sanguine Mend and Bloodmoon Blast on the target every 1 sec for 3 seconds.

modes.name: Pooled Vitality
modes.structural_description: Level 10 PassiveSpells that cost health now grant a stack of Pooled Vitality, stacking 10 times.Mortal Form spells that cost Rage consume 10 stacks of Pooled Vitality to become empowered.

modes.name: Dark Liturgy
modes.structural_description: Requires Mortal FormForm a blood bond, healing a friendly target for 77 + 35% SP + 25% Spirit and applying Blood Rituals to them, bouncing to up to 10 nearby allies, healing for less for each target struck.Blood RitualsCauses Bloodmoon Blast to heal marked allies for 178 + 7% healing + 8.5% Stamina.

modes.name: Dark Blood
modes.structural_description: Reduces the cost of your abilities that require Cursed Form and increases the healing done by Blood Rituals by -25%.

modes.name: Dark Essence
modes.structural_description: Casting Cursed Form abilities or Bloodbolt will now heal allies affected by Blood Rituals for 114 + 10% healing every 1 sec for 3 seconds.

modes.name: Crimson Tide
modes.structural_description: Requires Mortal FormCreate a pool of blood beneath up to 10 enemies within 10 yds of you, causing them to bleed for 165 + 140% SP Shadow damage over 15 seconds.Empowered: Radius increased by 5 yds and costs -100% less Rage.

modes.name: Cursed Blood
modes.structural_description: Increases the damage dealt and spell power scaling of Bloodbolt, Bloodmoon Blast, and Crimson Tide by 20%.In addition, damage dealt by Bloodbolt now reduces all resistances by 75 and increases the target's Magic damage taken by 2% for 10 seconds.

modes.name: Adrenaline Boost
modes.structural_description: Increases the critical strike chance of abilities that require Cursed Form on enemies above 75% or below 35% health by 20%.In addition, melee critical strikes now have a 50% chance to make your next Dark Liturgy or Bloodmoon Blast instant cast.

mechanics.single_target: Maintain ritual coverage on the priority ally, convert damage casts into healing, and use direct blood transfers or shields when passive conversion is insufficient.
mechanics.aoe: Dark Liturgy chains through allies, later Dark Essence adds healing-over-time conversion, and Crimson Tide, Waves of Blood, and redistribution tools broaden group recovery.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Instant Sanguine Mend and proc-based healing help during movement, but ritual coverage and attack targets must remain valid for the conversion engine to work.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Aortic Aegis, Arterial Bind, Blood Redistribution, Hemoglobe, and purification effects manipulate damage rather than relying only on raw healing after the fact.
mechanics.group_utility: Blood-Cursed Weapons or Armor, damage-to-healing support, shields, bindings, and purification give Fleshweaver a hybrid contribution that ordinary healing meters may not fully explain.

failure_modes.text: Attacking without Blood Ritual coverage or letting the relevant buff fall off breaks the damage-to-healing conversion at the moment the group expects it.

Movement or a target swap can interrupt the intended payoff: instant sanguine mend and proc-based healing help during movement, but ritual coverage and attack targets must remain valid for the conversion engine to work.

Spending recovery or control too early leaves less protection for the next pressure event: aortic aegis, arterial bind, blood redistribution, hemoglobe, and purification effects manipulate damage rather than relying only on raw healing after the fact.

enjoy_if.text: You enjoy fistweaver-style healing where attacks, buffs, and direct emergency tools all matter.

You enjoy the spec's core cadence: use dark liturgy to establish blood ritual recipients, attack through bloodmoon blast and later proc-enabled damage so allies carrying the ritual are healed, manage sanguine essence and instant sanguine mend access, and reserve aortic aegis, arterial bind, blood redistribution, or purify blood for dangerous events.

avoid_if.text: You want a pure reactive healer with no damage target, recipient-buff, or stored-resource management.

You dislike the positioning or swap constraint that instant sanguine mend and proc-based healing help during movement, but ritual coverage and attack targets must remain valid for the conversion engine to work.

praise.theme: Current players report strong AoE damage, meaningful passive healing, and successful dungeon healing from level 15 through 60.

frustrations.theme: Early players can mistake Dark Liturgy spam for the whole spec or feel like only half a healer before later conversion talents arrive.

contested.theme: Some advice calls Dark Liturgy spam sufficient, while an experienced level-60 player calls that approach lazy and instead uses the broader damage-and-proc kit.

claims.notes: Mechanics explanation aligns with current structural talents.

claims.text: An August 2 player reports leveling from 15 to 60 plus heroic/mythic content as Fleshweaver, mostly through dungeons, and says higher-level play uses damage and healing procs rather than only Dark Liturgy spam. Another current player reports high AoE damage and substantial supplemental healing while leveling.
claims.notes: Player reports, not normalized logs.

claims.text: The August Mythic inventory lists 65 Fleshweaver records. The DPS compilation's 3,090 value is a support/off-role signal and cannot rank healing performance.
claims.notes: Representation is not power.

claims.text: Fleshweaver's damage-to-healing engine fails when the intended recipients lack Blood Ritual coverage, making buff targeting a higher-cost mistake than pressing a weak filler.
claims.notes: Exact coverage requirements vary by group size and build.
